evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Deliberate contrast: unrehearsed rollback opposed to not-having-it, matched clause structure ('A rollback we…' / 'a rollback we…') crystallizing a rule into antithesis.

mints.name: RuleAsMatchedOpposition
mints.title: a rollback we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is the speaker crystallizing a rule into matched opposed clauses so the second clause is the negation of the first?
